title: BlackX UEFI Bootkit Bypasses Secure Boot
excerpt: A new UEFI bootkit called BlackX used an older vulnerability to bypass Secure Boot during an espionage campaign.
body_html:
A newly discovered UEFI bootkit called BlackX was utilized in an espionage campaign in early 2026. The malicious software exploited the older Baton Drop vulnerability to successfully bypass Secure Boot protections.

Once executed, the bootkit loaded a malicious driver specifically designed to interfere with security solutions provided by Kaspersky and Avast.
